parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 172.16.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols bgp group external type ex.command: set protocols bgp group external type external

set protocols bgp group external peer-as.command: set protocols bgp group external peer-as 100

set protocols bgp group external neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group external neighbor 172.16.1.2

set protocols bgp group external family.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group external family.command: set protocols bgp group external family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group external family.explanation: 配置BGP组支持IPv4单播地址族。

set protocols bgp group external import.command: set protocols bgp group external import no-synchronization
set protocols bgp group external import.explanation: 配置BGP组不进行同步检查。

set protocols bgp group external import.command: set protocols bgp group external import export-direct-routes
set protocols bgp group external import.explanation: 配置BGP组导入直接路由的策略。

set protocols bgp group external neighbo.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] family inet [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group external neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group external neighbor 172.16.1.2 family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group external neighbo.explanation: 配置BGP组邻居支持IPv4单播地址族。

set policy-options policy-statement expo.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from protocol [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement expo.command: set policy-options policy-statement export-direct-routes term 1 from protocol direct
set policy-options policy-statement expo.explanation: 配置策略语句的匹配条件为直接路由。

set policy-options policy-statement expo.command: set policy-options policy-statement export-direct-routes term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement expo.explanation: 配置策略语句的操作为接受。
